fed.note: FOMC held the target range steady; dissenters Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack both wanted a 25bp hike. Chair Warsh called inflation "elevated" and said the Fed will cut the number of rate-setting meetings starting 2027.

catalysts.name: SoFi Technologies, Inc.
catalysts.what: Q3 2026: record adjusted net revenue of $1.37–1.4B (beat ~$1.26B consensus) and adjusted EPS $0.18 vs $0.17 consensus, adjusted EBITDA +70% y/y, 17.1M members. Raised FY2026 guidance to ~$5.04B adjusted net revenue / ~$1.66B adjusted EBITDA and introduced a 2027 outlook. Shares closed up ~13.4% on the day, the biggest one-day gain since April 2025.

catalysts.name: Vertiv Holdings Co
catalysts.what: Q3 2026 net sales $4,312.8M (+61% y/y) vs ~$3.75B consensus; diluted EPS +91% to $1.95, adjusted diluted EPS +78% to $2.21. Raised FY2026 guidance to $14,450–14,850M net sales (from ~$14.0B) and $7.10–$7.20 adjusted diluted EPS (from $6.65–6.75), citing accelerating AI data-center demand and organic orders more than doubling y/y.

catalysts.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
catalysts.what: Q3 2026: revenue $5.1B (+36% y/y, beat ~$4.56B consensus); non-GAAP diluted EPS $20.07 vs ~$16.19 consensus (+70% y/y). Sanofi-reported Dupixent sales +35% y/y to $6.5B (Regeneron now books its full profit share); EYLEA HD US sales +62% y/y to $699M, with FY2026 EYLEA HD sales guided to grow >50% y/y even as original EYLEA faces biosimilar pressure. Expanded Sanofi collaboration adds a $1.0B upfront payment (booked Q4 2026) plus up to $7.0B in milestones. Shares hit a new 52-week high, +11–13% on the day across sources.

SOFI.what: Consumer fintech (SoFi Bank): student/personal/home lending, investing and cash management, plus the Galileo and Technisys banking-infrastructure platforms.

VRT.what: Digital-infrastructure supplier (Liebert, NetSure, Geist): power management, thermal control and rack/IT systems for AI data centers, communications networks and industrial customers.

REGN.what: Biopharmaceutical: Eylea/Eylea HD (wet AMD, diabetic eye disease), Dupixent (atopic dermatitis, asthma; profit-shared with Sanofi), plus Libtayo, Praluent and a broadening oncology/rare-disease pipeline.
